description: A U.S. Air Force F-15E Strike Eagle assigned to the 494th Expeditionary Fighter Squadron, conducts a formation fly over honoring Qatar National Day, Doha, Qatar Dec. 18, 2019. Qatar National Day is an annual holiday for Qataris to commemorate their national identity and history, and allows them to remember how their national unity was achieved.
